Press conference

Introductory statement

The Governing Council will not pre-commit to a specific rate path.

Uncertainty surrounding the outlook remains high.

Questions and answers

Question: Some investors expect a rate cut. Can you confirm a rate hike is coming?

Answer: We do not confirm market expectations. We will decide on the basis of the incoming data.

Question: Is the Council planning to reduce the deposit facility rate to 1.50%?

Answer: We have made no such decision.

European Central Bank, 2026
